faq_heading: 3 bedroom condos in Surrey: your questions answered

faq.q: What is the price of a 3 bedroom condo in Surrey right now?
faq.a: Of the 3 bedroom condos in Surrey, 38 sold over the past year at a median of $579,500, with the middle half between $521,250 and $625,750.

faq.q: Are 3 bedroom condos in Surrey selling quickly?
faq.a: The median was 33 days, and homes sold for 97.0% of the list price at a median.

faq.q: Which parts of Surrey sell the most 3 bedroom condos?
faq.a: Fleetwood Tynehead, with 12 of the 38 sales at a median of $592,500.

faq.q: Which buildings in Surrey have 3 bedroom condos for sale most often?
faq.a: By sales over the past year: Fleetwood Village (6 sales, median $590,000).

faq.q: What is the strata fee on a 3 bedroom condo in Surrey?
faq.a: The median strata fee on the 3 bedroom condos that sold in Surrey was $503 a month. Fees vary by building, so check the building's own figure.
